desc: Derive the exact contribution of a single length-\(p\) walk after summing independently over all zero entries.
Identify all possible multiplicity patterns of zero-valued matrix positions in a surviving walk of length \(p\).
Convert the walk characterization into efficient matrix products and modular exponentiation.
Check special cases \(p=2\), no zeros, diagonal zeros, and non-diagonal zero contributions for \(p=3\).
Design and validate the final Python solution; it passed all public samples.
